;Disasters and accidents
*[[Sinking of Hableány|Sinking of ''Hableány'']]
**The ''Hableány'', a sightseeing river cruise ship on the [[Danube]] in [[Budapest]], capsizes and sinks with 34 South Korean tourists on board. At least seven people are killed and 19 remain missing. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/05/29/world/europe/hungary-boat-sinks.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Law and crime
*A 55-year-old pediatrician, Ricardo Russo, is arrested at the [[Hospital Garrahan]] in [[Buenos Aires]], Argentina, where he was Chief of the Immunology Department. He is accused of sexually abusing minors, distributing and possessing child pornography, including handicapped children and babies. He was wanted by the U.S. [[FBI]] and public prosecutors in Brazil. [https://www.clarin.com/sociedad/detuvieron-pediatra-garrahan-produccion-distribucion-pornografia-infantil_0_sN4CJj_Rb.html (''Clarín'')] [https://www.foxnews.com/world/pediatrician-argentina-childrens-hospital-child-pornography (Fox News)]
*[[Maine]] becomes the 17th U.S. state to [[List of U.S. jurisdictions banning conversion therapy|ban]] [[conversion therapy]] for [[Minor (law)|minors]]. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/445980-maine-officially-bans-gay-conversion-therapy (''The Hill'')]

**[[Israel]] is expected to hold a [[September 2019 Israeli legislative election|new election]] on September 17 as [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] fails to form a government.
